quotes.text:
shown:
    type: event
    description: >
      Notification is selected to be shown.

closed:
    type: event
    description: >
      Close button of a notification is clicked.
    bugs:
      - https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1919278
    data_reviews:
      - https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1919278#c4
    data_sensitivity:
      - interaction
    notification_emails:
      - telemetry-client-dev@thunderbird.net
    expires: never
    extra_keys:
      notification_id:
        description: ID of the notification
        type: string
      active_this_session:
        description: Amount of seconds this notification was active in this session.
        type: quantity
  dismissed:
    type: event
    description: >
      Notification is no longer shown without any user interaction.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 1031 records closed for a valid explicit dismissNotification call, interaction for the CTA, and dismissed when the active notification expires or disappears from the candidate list. It records shown when a UI notification is selected. Metric descriptions distinguish these transitions. Keep the semantic event names aligned with their actual producer, rather than calling every removal a close. The accepted code retains the distinction; no data submission or event execution was run.
title: Keep notification close and passive dismissal as different telemetry events
